messages:
toni: Heads-up — I'm updating the Reserved pool isolation doc to add an example using "isolation decorators" plus a Go SDK snippet and a CLI example. Draft PR incoming, can infra + docs eyeball for migration phrasing?

brad: Go snippet would be great. infra likes strongly-typed examples. Also call out the precise SLA sentence for eviction behavior pls.

anya: One-liner SLA we can put near the top: what do we promise for reserved pools vs per-job eviction?

toni: Draft YAML I'm planning to include in the provisioning section:
```yaml
reserved_capacity:
  tenant: tenant-xyz
  min_nodes: 1
  max_nodes: 10
  isolation:
    decorator: tenant-strict
    preemption: false
  eviction_window_seconds: 300
```

toni: Go SDK snippet for the same config (short form for docs):
```go
import "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk"

client := sdk.NewDedicatedClient()
policy := sdk.ReservedPolicy{
  Tenant: "tenant-xyz",
  MinNodes: 1,
  MaxNodes: 10,
  Isolation: sdk.Isolation{Decorator: "tenant-strict", Preemption: false},
  EvictionWindowSeconds: 300,
}
client.ApplyReservedPolicy(policy)
```

brad: CLI folks also want a tiny example. suggestion:
```
redwoodctl reserved set --tenant tenant-xyz --min 1 --max 10 --isolation tenant-strict --no-preempt --eviction 300
```

anya: Draft SLA blurb suggestion: "Reserved-pool uptime SLAs guarantee the availability of the pool itself; individual workload placement may still be subject to transient eviction during region-level capacity pressure. eviction_window_seconds represents the recommended grace period for rescheduling and graceful shutdown, but does not change the reserved-pool uptime commitment."

brad: NIT: API v2.1 exposes `eviction_window_seconds` (snake_case) — the Go SDK maps to EvictionWindowSeconds. Add a short migration note.

toni: Adding migration note: "If migrating from older schemas: rename `preemptible` -> `preemption` (boolean flip semantics: older `preemptible: true` => `preemption: true`), and convert `eviction_ms` -> `eviction_window_seconds` by dividing by 1000."

infra-bot: docs-preview available for PR #2456 — https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/pr-2456 (build queued)

brad: Can someone run a quick sim to validate graceful teardown timing with eviction_window_seconds=300? I can do an infra sim tomorrow.

anya: LGTM on wording; maybe add a tiny callout that `decorator: tenant-strict` implies node affinity + no noisy-neighbor scheduling.

toni: Good callout, will add. Merging after lint + preview check. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: docs build passed for PR #2456 -> staging at 2026-03-24T14:08:12Z

toni: Merged and added the example to the onboarding checklist; tagging eng-ml and support for awareness. Closing thread.
